question: Which of the following types of crops are sown after the end of the monsoon season?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rabi crops**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rabi crops** are sown after the end of the monsoon season, typically in the months of October and November.
 
• The term "Rabi" means spring in Arabic, and these crops are harvested in the spring season, around April and May.
